notes.text: Ithebhu ethi Amabhalansi ayisabonisi umugqa wamaqanda lapho kungekho muntu okweletayo: ithi nje Konke kuxazululiwe.
Kulungisiwe i-Iphrofayela ebonisa ilogo ye-Apple eceleni kwe-imeyili ye-akhawunti engene ngemvume nge-Google, noma ye-Google eceleni kweyangene nge-Apple, lapho i-akhawunti inazo zombili.
